interest: Shows Japan's 1938 cultural and economic courting of Peru, balanced against Peru's resistance to immigration concessions.
overview: Docket (Sept-Dec 1938) on a Peruvian economic-cultural mission to Japan, discussing cotton, textiles, and a trade treaty while resisting immigration demands, followed by Riva-Agüero's cultural-society mission.

people.name: José de la Riva-Agüero
people.role: Former Peruvian Prime Minister and cultural envoy to Japan
variants: Dr. José de la Riva Aguero

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing a telegram regarding the Peruvian Foreign Minister's reaction to press reports of official talks during the Peruvian mission's visit to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference: Peru's Foreign Minister insists its mission to Japan was purely cultural, annoyed by press reports of official talks.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet for Telegram No. 462 from Dreyfus (Lima) on Peruvian Mission to Japan

subfiles.about: Cross-reference sheet indexing a Tokyo despatch concerning the Peruvian Economic and Cultural Mission's visit and the arrival of cultural envoy José de la Riva-Agüero.
subfiles.summary: Cross-reference: Grew reports Peru's mission was lavishly entertained in Japan but lacked authority to commit, plus Riva-Agüero's cultural-envoy visit.
subfiles.title: Cross-reference sheet for Despatch No. 3521 from Grew (Tokyo) on Peruvian Mission and Cultural Envoy

subfiles.about: Extract from an embassy political report reviewing the Peruvian mission's tour and economic discussions in Japan, as well as the arrival of cultural envoy Dr. José de la Riva-Agüero.
subfiles.summary: Political report: Peru's cultural-economic mission toured Japan discussing cotton, textiles, and a trade treaty while deflecting immigration demands; ex-PM Riva-Agüero later arrived to found a cultural society.
subfiles.title: Section of Tokyo Embassy Political Report on Peruvian Economic and Cultural Mission and Cultural Envoy
